scope: Independent WebGL2 GPU measurements of actual carrier distance, phase, froth, velocity, and shared optical helper. Production reflection/transmission normal and absorption/transmission/scatter expressions are extracted for isolated interface probes. Color function and detached-drop intersection are inert only to isolate carrier rays and omit full-scene compilation. Weight tests certify an interface partition, not total radiance, real multi-interface refraction, natural appearance, upstream solver execution, or Minecraft. Retired revision7 single-cos/Fourier metrics stay raw in observations and are excluded from passed.
